about: The ore furnace of the mine yards (Processor/Furnace.et and the pack's LF_MineFurnace.et, both through SmelterFurnace.xob): a small red-brick furnace on a brick hearth, bound with iron corner angles and straps, a cast-iron firebox door with a glowing peep slot and an ash pit below it, an iron cap plate with a rusted sheet-steel ore hopper on top, and a round iron chimney with a rain cap at the back. Built by build.py in headless Blender from boxes, frustums and cylinders with procedural textures; it replaces the 2026-11-12 Meshy stand-in (spec.json and meshy.json in this folder are that stand-in's record). The base game has no furnace; Meshy is reserved for fish and masks. Core asset: no text, no brand.

layout_m.about: Enfusion metres, x right, y up, z forward; the fire door faces +z. The body keeps the stand-in's footprint (about 1 x 1 m, front plane z +0.5) so the use point (0 0.70 0.5055) stays on the door and the drop offset (0 0 1.6) lands in front of it; the hearth adds 5 cm a side, the hopper and chimney stand on top.

emissive.about: The door atlas: the peep slot and the ash pit glow orange.
